action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check all listening ports for node
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep node 2>&1")
print("Node ports:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check process
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("lsof -i -P -n | grep -E 'node|areloria' 2>&1 | head -10")
print("\nlsof:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
